title: Connect rigid and deformable interactions to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind the existing F8-17 and relevant F8-19 operators for rigid/cloth, rigid/soft-body, rigid/rope, cloth/soft-body, cloth/rope and soft-body/rope to the common production schedule. Cover only modes already in the canonical implemented capability matrix. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Enumerate exact existing contact/attachment modes from the canonical capability inventory and run every applicable edge through installed public graph creation and native dispatch.
Both endpoints use one state/spatial epoch, four fixed coupling sweeps and one commit; no duplicate integration, per-edge index rebuild or hidden synchronization.
Independent contact/attachment, reciprocal impulse and mixed-family quality gates pass on an applicable physical GPU; include three-family graphs and endpoint reversal.
Rebinding, destruction, stale generations and capacity failure preserve atomic graph/state ownership; unsupported modes remain explicit.
